text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, invited by Mejiro Ardan, I 
arrived at the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Thank you so much for taking 
the trouble to join us for Nanny's 
recovery celebration.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to offer my thanks as well. It 
sounds as though Milady has received 
immense support from you.
choice_data_list: Not at all, I only lent a small hand.
Not at all, I only lent a hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Please, there is no need to be modest. I 
have been continually saved by your 
precise advice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
As a small token of gratitude today, I 
truly hope you will enjoy yourself to the 
fullest.
choice_data_list: Oh right, what kind of gift is it?

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I have yet to be told either. 
Would you be so kind as to enlighten us 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Wishing to bring Nanny true joy, I 
have prepared something exceptionally 
dazzling. Namely—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Last time, I learned that Nanny is a 
banquet aficionado and is fond of 
glamorous, flashy things. So I chose the 
most dazzling thing I could think of.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
A banquet aficionado...? No, more 
importantly, how on earth did you make 
such arrangements? Surely, not by 
yourself, Milady...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, goodness no. That would be 
impossible. You overestimate me far too 
much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
The preparations are being handled by 
pyrotechnicians introduced to me through 
the Mejiro family connections—

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician A
text_block_list.text:
You idiot!! Why the heck did you put it 
there?! How're you gonna fix this!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, is there a problem?

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician A
text_block_list.text:
Well, the setup crew messed up, see. The 
launch mortar got placed in slightly the 
wrong spot.

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!! We really wanted to grant 
such a stylish wish for you, Ardan-san, 
but...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...... If the location is corrected, would 
it be possible to launch the finest 
fireworks?

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... yeah! It'll be the most beautiful 
display you've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: In that case... I shall carry it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
After all, I truly wish for Nanny to 
witness the best fireworks possible...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Hnnnghhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the pyrotechnicians supporting her, 
she hoisted the heavy mortar and 
successfully relocated it.

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician A
text_block_list.text:
You saved us, Ardan-san! From here on out, 
it's our turn. We'll put on the absolute 
best fireworks show for you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how gorgeous... I am so glad we could 
safely watch them together...

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, truly.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Once, Milady was so fragile and precarious 
that she seemed as though she might break 
at the slightest touch...

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
I have devoted my life to serving you, 
always thinking I must protect my young 
mistress.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
And now... today. That very same lady has 
arranged such an event all for this old 
nanny's sake...

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
While the fireworks bring me joy, of 
course—

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Just witnessing how strong and capable 
Milady has grown fills my heart to 
overflowing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Nanny...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amid the booming fireworks, I listened 
closely to the soft, fading words.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Milady, you have truly grown into 
someone so magnificent... I am... I am...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Nanny... Please keep those tears saved 
away for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Until the day my dream comes true... 
please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hearing you say so makes me very happy 
as well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Those fireworks also carried my sincere 
feelings of gratitude toward you, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
May tonight's fireworks become a cherished 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Nanny. Let us call out together as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
My, but... Considering Milady's public 
standing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is quite all right. Here we go. 
Ready, and—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Taaamaaayaaa!!
